mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, sender_id, message_type, content, extra_json, is_recall, create_time FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, session_id, sender_id, message_type, content, extra_json, is_recall, create_time FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (session_id, sender_id, message_type, content, extra_json, is_recall, create_time) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{senderId}, #{messageType}, #{content}, #{extraJson}, #{isRecall}, NOW())
